lines.text: [British accent] [fast, curious] Kerem, which screw? This one? Or this one? Are you sure?
[exasperated] Ellie, please... don't eat my head!
[British accent] [horrified] Eat your HEAD?! [pause] Kerem... I'm a vegetarian!
[deadpan] No problem. My English is perfect.
[playfully] Kafamı yeme demek istiyorsan: Stop bugging me! [pause] Üçüncü bölümde: My eye is on you! Kaçırma!
